selection.rule: Compare median sequential PATCH upload throughput of three paired 256MiB runs; prefer smaller chunk when difference <=10%; require response/resource checks and 1GiB confirmation
selection.reason: 4MiB was 1.64% faster in paired medians with smaller retry granularity; all three directory p95 regressions <=20%; 1GiB confirmation +6.499%
selection.notableException: 16MiB first paired run directory p95 +21.754% exceeded 20% target; retained in raw evidence
